title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of motor imagery brain-computer interface (BCI) use from 20 healthy participants, each recorded over 7 sessions on separate days. Participants performed cued imagery of left hand, right hand, both feet, and idle (rest) states without feedback, giving 33,600 trials recorded at 500 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system. This BIDS version was generated with MOABB and includes corrected channel naming, EOG and mastoid channels, and HED event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier (41 electrodes for subjects 1-12, 26 for subjects 13-20, plus hEOG/vEOG) at 500 Hz. Online filtering was 0.5-100 Hz with a 50 Hz notch, referenced to Cz with AFz ground. Each of 7 daily sessions had 6 runs of 40 trials with visual arrow cues for 4 classes (left hand, right hand, feet, rest) and no feedback. Each trial's imagery period lasted 5 s.
